help.description: Shows the available commands and how to use the bot
help.title: 🤖 AI Assistant Bot - Help
help.intro: Hi! I'm an AI bot. Send me a direct message to chat. All `/` commands work in DMs with the bot.

usage.name: 💬 How does it work?
usage.value: Just send me a direct message — I'll answer with the help of AI. Run `/` commands in the same DM window.

userCommands.name: 📋 User commands
userCommands.value:
• `/help` — this message
• `/rules` — server rules
• `/code <message>` — coding mode
• `/flushmemory` — clear your conversation memory
• `/warnings` — show your warnings

adminCommands.name: 🔐 Admin commands
adminCommands.value:
• `/warnings [user]` — review warnings
• `/stats [days]` — bot statistics
• `/flushdb` — clear the database

note.name: ⚠️ Note
note.value: A command used in a server channel won't run — the bot will send you to DMs.
